phase: post-integration rendered discovery; Phase A unchanged

findings.location: labels[0..12], moving LacI/CAP updates and RNA annotation
findings.evidence: LacI, CAP and beta-galactosidase leaders end above their actual protein surfaces; CAP site/promoter/O1/lacZYA leaders terminate below the DNA; the RNA direction leader ends in empty space below every transcript. Lactose-to-allolactose annotation retains a fixed old text position while its displayed molecular target changes.
findings.whyWrong: ProcessScene and exported capture interpret label.position as the biological leader endpoint, not a text-layout offset. Concrete proteins, genes and RNA must target their actual visible geometry; region/status annotations must be distinguished from named molecular targets.
findings.fix: Bind molecular labels to transformed mesh surfaces, DNA instances or visible RNA geometry; synchronize active state and condition-dependent wording with the actual target. Retain valid compartment/status regional annotations.
findings.verification: Check actual target vertices/instances/visible draw ranges and transform-following across all 16 conditions, stages and irregular seeks; include negative controls restoring original photographed offsets and premature labels.
